title: Recovery Expense Rule: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Repossession Expenses, Storage and Personal Property
content:
**Recovery expense rule, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

1. A repossession expense can be charged only while the contract status is repossession assigned or repossessed.
2. The agency fee is the product's involuntary agency fee for an involuntary recovery and the product's voluntary agency fee for a voluntary surrender; the product's transport fee applies only to an involuntary recovery; the product's condition report fee is charged once per repossession.
3. Storage is charged at the product's daily storage fee for each day the vehicle is stored beyond the product's free storage days, counting from the repossession date to the release or sale date, and is billed when the vehicle leaves the lot. The storage charge is the daily fee times the stored days less the free days, never below zero.
4. Personal property found in the vehicle is inventoried and held free of charge; the customer may collect it in person or have it shipped at the carrier's cost.
5. Personal property may be disposed of only after the product's hold period has fully elapsed from the date the vehicle was repossessed. The hold is counted in calendar days starting the day after the repossession date; disposal is permitted from the calendar day after the repossession date plus the hold days.
6. Expenses are booked to fees due and become part of any reinstatement, redemption or deficiency amount.

## Expenses by kind of recovery

| Expense | Involuntary recovery | Voluntary surrender |
|---|---|---|
| Agency fee | involuntary agency fee | voluntary agency fee |
| Transport fee | charged | not charged |
| Condition report fee | once per repossession | once per repossession |
| Storage | days beyond the free days | days beyond the free days |

## Personal property hold as a time test

*Boundary cases (abstract):* with a hold of P days, disposal is not permitted on day P after the repossession date, the last day of the hold; it is permitted from day P plus 1.
